events.content: CoreWeave customer concentration largest customer revenue percentage Q2 FY2026

**CoreWeave remains highly concentrated in Microsoft, not OpenAI, on recognized revenue.** Microsoft accounted for approximately **67% of FY2025 revenue** ($5.131 billion), or roughly **$3.44 billion**, versus 62% in FY2024 and 35% in FY2023. [[1]] 

OpenAI was **not a ≥10% revenue customer in FY2025**: CoreWeave disclosed that no customer other than Microsoft represented 10% or more of FY2025 revenue. [[1]] 

That said, OpenAI is an exceptionally material **forward backlog/customer-credit exposure** rather than a disclosed current-revenue concentration. Its initial March 2025 agreement committed OpenAI to pay up to approximately **$11.9 billion through October 2030**, and a September 2025 order form added up to approximately **$6.5 billion through May 2031**; CoreWeave explicitly said it expected OpenAI to become a significant future customer. [[2]] 

CoreWeave subsequently described total OpenAI contract value at approximately **$22.4 billion**, including the initial agreement, a May 2025 expansion, and the September expansion. [[3]]

**Bottom line:** Microsoft is the dominant near-term P&L concentration risk—two-thirds of FY2025 sales—while OpenAI is the major medium-term concentration and counterparty risk embedded in contracted backlog and planned capacity deployment. [[4]] [[2]]

Sources:
[S3.1] CoreWeave revenue surges to $5.1B on AI cloud boom — https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/CRWV/10-k-core-weave-inc-files-annual-report-765643168fc2.html
[S3.2] UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION Washington, D.C. 20549 — https://s205.q4cdn.com/133937190/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CoreWeave-Inc-FY25-10-K-7.pdf
[S3.3] CoreWeave - CoreWeave Expands Agreement with OpenAI by up to $6.5B — https://investors.coreweave.com/news/news-details/2025/CoreWeave-Expands-Agreement-with-OpenAI-by-up-to-6-5B/default.aspx
[S3.4] CoreWeave SEC Filings, Annotated — AI Capex — MTS — MTS — https://drops.mts.now/ai-capex/wiki/documents/coreweave-filings/

tool_arguments.summary:
CoreWeave's key financial metrics (most recent fiscal periods):

- **Q2 FY2026 Revenue**: $2.575 billion (3 months ended June 30, 2026), up from $1.212 billion in Q2 FY2025. Source: S1.1.
- **Contracted Backlog**: ~$104 billion as of June 30, 2026 (end of Q2 FY2026). Source: S2.1.
- **Customer Concentration (FY2025)**: Microsoft accounted for ~67% of revenue (~$3.44 billion of $5.131 billion), vs. 62% in FY2024 and 35% in FY2023. No other customer reached 10% of FY2025 revenue. Source: S3.1, S3.2.
- **OpenAI Commitment**: Total contract value approximately $22.4 billion (initial $11.9B through 2030 + $6.5B expansion through 2031 + later additions). OpenAI is not a current revenue % customer but is a major medium-term backlog/counterparty risk. Source: S3.3, S3.4.

These figures are drawn from CoreWeave's Q2 FY2026 earnings release, its FY2025 10‑K filing, and subsequent expansion disclosures.
